summary.en-US: Watch and control your Logos node over Tor

description.en-US:
Watch, control and receive notifications from a Logos blockchain node running
in Basecamp on your desktop — from your phone, over a Tor v3 onion service
with client authorization.

Pair by scanning a QR code shown on the desktop. From then on the phone can
see the node's height, peers, sync state, blend status, balance and errors,
and can start or stop it. No account, no server in the middle, no port
forwarding.

Tor is embedded in the app — Orbot is not required, and there are no Google
Play Services. There is no analytics, no telemetry and no network destination
other than your own node.

It does NOT hide from your internet provider that you use Tor, on either end.
See the privacy documentation for what the onion service does and does not
protect.

NOT AN OFFICIAL LOGOS PRODUCT. Independent project, not endorsed by or
affiliated with Logos or IFT.
